name: TimeEA
summary: TimeEA is a time-based Expert Advisor that executes trades during specific time sessions. It uses time window filters to determine entry points, opening positions at designated trading hours. The EA relies on time-of-day patterns rather than technical indicators for its trading signals.
summary_zh: TimeEA是一个基于时间的智能交易系统，在特定时段执行交易。它使用时间窗口过滤器来确定入场点，在指定的交易时段开仓。该EA依赖日内时间模式而非技术指标来产生交易信号。
strategy_analysis: TimeEA的核心策略概念是基于时段交易，即在特定的时间窗口内开仓交易，利用市场在不同时段的波动特征获取利润。入场条件主要依赖于当前服务器时间是否落在用户设定的时间范围内，当时间匹配时触发交易信号。出场条件通常包括止盈和止损设置，也可能在特定时间窗口结束时平仓。仓位管理方面，EA使用固定手数或基于资金比例的手数计算方式。资金管理依赖于止损和止盈的设置，但缺乏动态调整止损的机制。整体策略逻辑简单直接，但过度依赖时间因素而忽略价格行为和技术分析，存在一定的局限性。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of TimeEA is session-based trading, executing positions within specific time windows to exploit market volatility patterns characteristic of different trading sessions. Entry conditions primarily depend on whether the current server time falls within user-defined time ranges, triggering trade signals when the time matches. Exit conditions typically include take-profit and stop-loss settings, and may also close positions when the time window ends. Position sizing uses either fixed lot sizes or balance-proportional lot calculation methods. Money management relies on stop-loss and take-profit settings but lacks dynamic trailing stop mechanisms. The overall strategy logic is simple and straightforward, but it is overly reliant on time factors while ignoring price action and technical analysis, presenting certain limitations.

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术号码用于识别订单

pros: 策略逻辑简单明了，易于理解和配置
利用不同时段的市场特征，能够捕捉高波动性时段的交易机会
时间过滤有效避免了低流动性时段的风险
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic, easy to understand and configure
Exploits market characteristics of different sessions, capturing trading opportunities during high volatility periods
Time filtering effectively avoids risks during low liquidity sessions
cons: 仅依赖时间因素进行交易决策，缺乏技术分析确认信号
没有动态止损和追踪止损机制，风险控制较为僵化
缺乏市场状态判断，在趋势不明朗时仍可能开仓导致亏损
cons_en: Relies solely on time factors for trading decisions without technical analysis confirmation signals
No dynamic stop-loss or trailing stop mechanism, making risk control relatively rigid
Lacks market state assessment, may still open positions during unclear trends leading to losses
improvements: 增加技术指标确认（如均线、RSI）作为辅助入场条件，提高信号质量
实现动态追踪止损功能，以保护已有利润并优化出场策略
improvements_en: Add technical indicator confirmation (such as moving averages, RSI) as auxiliary entry conditions to improve signal quality
Implement dynamic trailing stop functionality to protect existing profits and optimize exit strategy

risk_points: 仅基于时间开仓，无技术面确认，可能在不利的行情中入场
固定止损止盈未考虑市场波动率变化，在高波动时段可能频繁触发止损
risk_points_en: Opens positions based solely on time without technical confirmation, may enter during unfavorable market conditions
Fixed stop-loss and take-profit do not account for market volatility changes, may frequently trigger stops during high volatility sessions

summary_en: TimeEA is a time-based Expert Advisor that executes trades during specific time sessions. It uses time window filters to determine entry points, opening positions at designated trading hours. The EA relies on time-of-day patterns rather than technical indicators for its trading signals.
